dhevuni kumaarudaina yesu kreesthu suvaartha praarambhamu.
idigo naa doothanu neeku mundhugaa pampuchunnaanu; athadu nee maargamu siddhaparachunu.
prabhuvu maargamu siddhaparachudi, aayana trovalu saraalamu cheyudani aranyamulo kekaveyuchunna okanishabdamu ani pravakthayaina yeshayaachetha vraayabadinattu
baapthismamichu yohaanu aranyamulo undi paapakshamaapananimitthamu maarumanassu vishayamaina baapthi smamu prakatinchuchu vacchenu.
anthata yoodaya dheshasthu landarunu, yerooshalemu vaarandarunu, bayaludheri athani yoddhaku vachi, thama paapamulanu oppukonuchu, yordaanu nadhilo athanichetha baapthismamu ponduchundiri.
yohaanu onte romamula vastramunu molachuttu thooludattiyu dharinchu konuvaadu, adavi thenenu miduthalanu thinuvaadu.
mariyu athadunaakante shakthimanthudokadu naavenuka vachuchunnaadu; nenu vangi aayana cheppulavaarunu vipputaku paatrudanukaanu;
nenu neellalo meeku baapthismamichithini gaani aayana parishuddhaatmalo meeku baapthismamichunani cheppi prakatinchuchundenu.
aa dinamulalo yesu galilayaloni najarethunundi vachi yordaanulo yohaanuchetha baapthismamu pondhenu.
ventane aayana neellalonundi oddunaku vachuchundagaa aakaashamu chilchabadutayu, parishuddhaatma paavuramuvale thanameediki digivachutayu chuchenu.
mariyu neevu naa priyakumaarudavu, neeyandu nenaanandinchuchunnaanani yoka shabdamu aakaashamunundi vacchenu.
ventane parishuddhaatma aayananu aranyamuloniki trosikonipoyenu.
aayana saathaanuchetha shodhimpabaduchu aranyamulo naluvadhidinamulu adavimrugamulathookooda nundenu; mariyu dhevadoothalu aayanaku paricharya cheyuchundiri.
yohaanu cherapattabadina tharuvaatha yesu
kaalamu sampoornamaiyunnadhi, dhevuniraajyamu sameepinchi yunnadhi;maarumanassu pondi suvaartha nammudani cheppuchu dhevuni suvaartha prakatinchuchu,galilayaku vacchenu.
aayana galilaya samudratheeramuna velluchundagaa seemonunu seemonu sahodarudagu andreyayu, samudramulo valaveyuta chuchenu; vaaru jaalarulu.
yesunaa vembadi randi, nenu mimmunu manushyulanu pattu jaalarulanugaa chesedhanani vaarithoo cheppenu.
ventane vaaru thama valalu vidichi aayananu vembadinchiri.
aayana inka konthadooramu velli jebedayi kumaarudagu yaakobunu athani sahodarudagu yohaanunu chuchenu; vaaru donelo undi thama valalu baaguchesikonuchundiri.
ventane aayana vaarini piluvagaa vaaru thama thandriyaina jebedayini donelo jeethagaandrayoddha vidichipetti aayananu vembadinchiri.
anthata vaaru kapernahoomuloniki velliri. Ventane aayana vishraanthidinamuna samaajamandiramuloniki poyi bodhinchenu.
aayana shaastrulavale gaaka adhikaaramu galavaanivale vaariki bodhinchenu ganuka vaaru aayana bodhaku aashcharyapadiri.
aa samayamuna vaari samaaja mandiramulo apavitraatmapattina manushyudokadundenu.
vaadu najareyudavagu yesoo, maathoo neekemi, mammu nashimpajeyutaku vachithivaa? neevevadavo naaku teliyunu; neevu dhevuni parishuddhudavu ani kekalu vesenu.
anduku yesu oorakundumu vaanini vidichipommani daanini gaddimpagaa
aa apavitraatma vaanini vilavilalaadinchi pedda kekavesi vaani vidichipoyenu.
andarunu vismayamondi idhemito? Yidi krottha bodhagaa unnadhe; eeyana adhikaaramuthoo apavitraatmalakunu aagnaapimpagaa avi aayanaku lobaduchunnavani yokanithoo okadu cheppukoniri.
ventane aayananugoorchina samaachaaramu tvaralo galilaya praanthamulandanthata vyaapinchenu.
ventane vaaru samaajamandiramulonundi velli, yaakobuthoonu yohaanuthoonu seemonu andreya anuvaariyinta praveshinchiri.
seemonu attha jvaramuthoo padiyundagaa, ventane vaaraamenugoorchi aayanathoo cheppiri.
aayana aamedaggaraku vachi, cheyyipatti aamenu levanettenu; anthata jvaramu aamenu vadalenu ganuka aame vaariki upachaaramu cheyasaagenu.
saayankaalamu proddu grunkinappudu, janulu sakala rogulanu dayyamulu pattinavaarini aayanayoddhaku theesikoni vachiri;
pattanamanthayu aa yintivaakita koodi yundenu.
aayana naanaavidha rogamulachetha peedimpabadina anekulanu svasthaparachi, anekamaina dayyamulanu vellagottenu. Avi thannu erigiyundinanduna aayana aa dayyamulanu maatalaadaniyyaledu.
aayana pendalakadane lechi yinkanu chaalaa chikatiyundagaane bayaludheri, aranyapradheshamunaku velli, akkada praarthana cheyuchundenu.
seemonunu athanithoo kooda nunnavaarunu aayananu vedakuchu velli
aayananu kanugoni,andaru ninnu vedakuchunnaarani aayanathoo cheppagaa
aayana ithara sameepa graamamulalonu nenu prakatinchunatlu velludamu randi; yindunimitthame gadaa nenu bayaludheri vachithinani vaarithoo cheppenu.
aayana galilayayandanthata vaari samaajamandiramulalopraka tinchuchu, dayyamulanu vellagottuchu nundenu.
oka kushtharogi aayanayoddhaku vachi aayanayeduta mokaalloonineekishtamaithe nannu shuddhunigaa cheyagalavani aayanathoo cheppi, aayananu vedukonagaa
aayana kanikarapadi, cheyyichaapi vaanini muttinaakishtame; neevu shuddhudavu kammani vaanithoo cheppenu.
ventane kushtharogamu vaanini vidichenu ganuka vaadu shuddhudaayenu.
appudaayana evanithoonu emiyu cheppaku sumee;

kaani neevu velli vaariki saakshyaarthamai nee dhehamunu yaajakuniki kanabarachu koni, neevu shuddhudavainanduku moshe niyaminchina kaanuka lanu samarpinchumani vaaniki khandithamugaa aagnaapinchi ventane vaanini pampivesenu.

ayithe vaadu velli daanini goorchi visthaaramugaa prakatinchutakunu, aa sangathi prachuramu cheyutakunu aarambhinchenu ganuka aayana ika pattanamulo bahirangamugaa praveshimpaleka, velupala aranya pradeshamulo nundenu. naludikkula nundi janulu aayana yoddhaku vachu chundiri.
konnidinamulaina pimmata aayana marala kaperna hoomuloniki vacchenu
aayana yinta unnaadani vinavachinappudu a nekulu koodivachiri ganuka vaakitanainanu vaariki sthalamu lekapoyenu. aayana vaariki vaakyamu bodhinchuchundagaa
kondaru pakshavaayuvugala oka manushyuni nalugurichetha moyinchukoni aayanayoddhaku theesikoni vachiri.
chaalamandi koodiyunnanduna vaaraayana yoddhaku cheraleka, aayana yunnachootiki paigaa inti kappu vippi, sanduchesi pakshavaayuvugalavaanini paruputhoone dimpiri.
yesu vaari vishvaasamu chuchi kumaarudaa, nee paapamulu kshamimpabadiyunnavani paksha vaayuvugalavaanithoo cheppenu.
shaastrulalo kondaru akkada koorchundiyundiri.
vaaru ithadu itlenduku cheppuchunnaadu? dhevadooshana cheyuchunnaadu gadaa; dhevudokkade thappa paapamunu kshamimpagalavaadevadani thama hrudayamulalo aalochinchukoniri.
vaaru thamalo thaamu eelaaguna aalochinchukonuta yesu ventane thana aatmalo telisikoni meereelaati sangathulu mee hrudayamulalo enduku aalochinchukonuchunnaaru?
ee pakshavaayuvugalavaanithoo nee paapamulu kshamimpa badiyunnavani chepputa sulabhamaa? neevu lechi nee parupetthi koni naduvumani chepputa sulabhamaa?
ayithe paapamulu kshaminchutaku bhoomimeeda manushyakumaaruniki adhikaaramu kaladani meeru telisikonavalenani vaarithoo cheppi
pakshavaayuvu galavaanini chuchineevu lechi nee parupetthikoni yintiki pommani neethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
thakshaname vaadu lechi, parupetthikoni, vaarandariyeduta nadachi poyenu ganuka, vaarandaru vibhraanthinondimanameelaati kaaryamulanu ennadunu choodaledani cheppukonuchu dhevuni mahimaparachiri.
aayana samudratheeramuna marala nadachipovuchundenu. Janulandarunu aayanayoddhaku raagaa aayana vaariki bodhinchenu.
aayana maargamuna velluchu, sunkapu mettunoddha koorchunna alphayi kumaarudagu levini chuchi nannu vembadinchumani athanithoo cheppagaa, athadu lechi, aayananu vembadinchenu.
athani yinta aayana bhojana munaku koorchundiyundagaa, sunkarulunu paapulunu anekulu yesuthoonu aayana shishyulathoonu koorchundi yundiri. Ittivaaranekulundiri; vaaraayananu vembadinchu vaarairi.
parisayyulalonunna shaastrulu aayana sunkarulathoonu paapulathoonu bhujinchuta chuchi aayana sunkarulathoonu paapulathoonu kalisi bhojanamu cheyu chunnaademani aayana shishyula nadugagaa
yesu aa maata vinirogulake gaani aarogyamugalavaariki vaidyu dakkaraledu; nenu paapulane piluva vachithinigaani neethi manthulanu piluvaraaledani vaarithoo cheppenu.

yohaanu shishyulunu parisayyulunu upavaasamu cheyuta kaddu. Vaaru vachiyohaanu shishyulunu parisayyula shishyulunu upavaasamu cheyuduru gaani nee shishyulu upavaasamu cheyaru; deeniki hethuvemani aayana nadugagaa
yesupendlikumaarudu thamathookooda unna kaalamuna pendli intivaaru upavaasamu cheyadagunaa? Pendlikumaarudu thamathookooda unnanthakaalamu upavaasamu cheyadagadu gaani
pendlikumaarudu vaari yoddhanundi konipobadu dinamulu vachunu; aa dinamula lone vaarupavaasamu chethuru.
evadunu paathabattaku krotthagudda maasika veyadu; vesinayedala aa krotthamaasika paathabattanu velithiparachunu, chinugu mari ekkuvagunu.

evadunu paatha thitthulalo krottha draakshaarasamu poyadu; posinayedala draakshaarasamu aa thitthulanu pigulchunu, rasamunu thitthulunu chedunu; ayithe krottha draakshaarasamu krottha thitthulalo poyavalenani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana vishraanthidinamuna pantachelalobadi velluchundagaa, shishyulu maargamuna saagipovuchu vennulu trunchuchunundiri.
anduku parisayyuluchoodumu, vishraanthidinamuna cheyakoodanidi vaarela cheyu chunnaarani aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana vaarithoo itlanenu thaanunu thanathoo kooda nunnavaarunu aakaligoni nanduna daaveedunaku avasaramu vachinappudu athadu chesinadhi meerennadunu chaduvaledaa?
abyaathaarupradhaana yaajakudai yundagaa dhevamandiramuloniki velli, yaajakule gaani yitharulu thinakoodani samukhapu rottelu thaanu thini, thanathookooda unnavaarikicchenu gadaa ani cheppenu.
mariyu vishraanthidinamu manushyulakorake niyamimpabadenu gaani manushyulu vishraanthidinamukoraku niyamimpabadaledu.
anduvalana manushyakumaarudu vishraanthidinamunakunu prabhuvai yunnaadani vaarithoo cheppenu.
samaajamandiramulo aayana marala praveshimpagaa akkada oochacheyyi galavaadu okadundenu.
acchati vaaru aayanameeda neramu mopavalenaniyundi, vishraanthi dinamuna vaanini svasthaparachunemo ani aayananu kani pettuchundiri.
aayananeevu lechi na madhyanu niluvumani oochacheyyigalavaanithoo cheppi
vaarini chuchivishraanthi dinamuna melucheyuta dharmamaa keedu cheyuta dharmamaa? Praanarakshana dharmamaa, praanahatya dharmamaa! Ani adi genu; anduku vaaru oorakundiri.
aayana vaari hrudaya kaathinyamunaku duḥkhapadi, kopamuthoo vaarini kalaya chuchinee cheyyichaapumani aa manushyunithoo cheppenu; vaadu thana cheyyi chaapagaa adhi baagupadenu.
parisayyulu velupaliki poyi ventane herodeeyulathoo kalisikoni, aayana nelaagu sanharinthumaa yani aayanaku virodhamugaa aalochana chesiri.
yesu thana shishyulathoo kooda samudramunoddhaku vellagaa, galilayanundi vachina goppa janasamoohamu aayananu vembadinchenu,

mariyu aayana inni goppa kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaadani vini janulu yoodayanundiyu, yerooshalemunundiyu, idoomayanundiyu, yordaanu avathalanundiyu, thooru seedonu anedi pattanapraantha mulanundiyu aayanayoddhaku gumpulu gumpulugaa vachiri.
janulu gumpukoodagaa chuchi, vaaru thanaku iruku kaligimpakundunatlu chinnadone yokati thanaku siddha parachiyunchavalenani aayana thana shishyulathoo cheppenu.
aayana anekulanu svasthaparachenu ganuka rogapeedithulaina vaarandaru aayananu muttukonavalenani aayanameeda padu chundiri.
apavitraatmalu pattinavaaru aayananu chooda gaane aayana yeduta saagilapadi neevu dhevuni kumaarudavani cheppuchu kekaluvesiri.
thannu prasiddhicheyavaddani aayana vaariki khandithamugaa aagnaapinchenu.
aayana kondekki thanakishtamainavaarini piluvagaa vaaraa yana yoddhaku vachiri.
vaaru thanathoo kooda undunatlunu dayyamulanu vellagottu
adhikaaramugalavaarai suvaartha prakatinchutakunu vaarini pampavalenani aayana pandrendu mandhini niyaminchenu.
vaarevara nagaa'aayana pethuranu perupettina seemonu
jebedayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, athani sahodarudagu yohaanu; veeriddariki aayana boya nergesanu perupettenu; boyanergesu anagaa urimedu vaarani arthamu.
andreya, philippu, bartolomayi, matthayi, thoomaa, alphayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, thaddayi, kanaaneeyudaina seemonu,
aayananu appaginchina iskariyothu yoodhaa anuvaaru.
aayana intiloniki vachinappudu janulu marala gumpu koodi vachiri ganuka bhojanamu cheyutakainanu vaariki veelu lekapoyenu.
aayana intivaaru sangathi vini, aayana mathi chalinchiyunnadani cheppi aayananu pattukonaboyiri.
yerooshalemunundi vachina shaastrulu ithadu bayaljeboolu pattinavaadai dayyamula yadhipathichetha dayyamulanu vellagottuchunnaadani cheppiri.
appudaayana vaarini thana yoddhaku pilichi, upamaanareethigaa vaarithoo itlanenu saathaanu saathaanu nelaagu vellagottunu?
oka raajyamu thanaku thaane virodhamugaa verupadinayedala, aa raajyamu niluvaneradu.
oka yillu thanukuthaane virodhamugaa veru padina yedala, aa yillu niluvaneradu.
saathaanu thanaku thaane virodhamugaa lechi verupadina yedalavaadu niluva leka kadatherunu.
okadu balavanthudainavaanini modata bandhinchithene thappa, aa balavanthuni intajochi vaani saamagri dochukonaneradu; bandhinchina yedala vaani yillu dochukonavachunu.
samastha paapamulunu manushyulu cheyu dooshanalanniyu vaariki kshamimpabadunu gaani
parishuddhaatma vishayamu dooshanacheyuvaadeppudunu kshamaapana pondaka nityapaapamu chesinavaadai yundunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
endu kanagaa aayana apavitraatma pattinavaadani vaaru cheppiri.
aayana sahodarulunu thalliyu vachi velupala nilichi aayananu piluvanampiri. Janulu gumpugaa aayanachuttu koorchundiri.
vaaru'idigo nee thalliyu nee sahodaru lunu velupala undi, neekosaramu vedakuchunnaarani aaya nathoo cheppagaa
aayananaa thalli naa sahodarulu evarani
thana chuttukoorchunna vaarini kalayachuchi idigo naa thalliyu naa sahodarulunu;
dhevuni chitthamu choppuna jariginchuvaade naa sahodarudunu sahodariyu thalliyunani cheppenu.

aayana samudratheeramuna marala bodhimpa naarambhimpagaa, bahu janulaayanayoddhaku koodivachi yunnanduna aayana samudramulo oka doneyekki koorchuṁ denu. Janulandaru samudratheeramuna nelameeda nundiri.
aayana upamaanareethigaa chaala sangathulu vaariki bodhiṁ chuchu thana bodhalo vaarithoo itlanenu
vinudi; idigo vitthuvaadu vitthutaku bayaluvellenu.
vaadu vitthu chundagaa konni vitthanamulu trovaprakkanu padenu. Pakshuluvachi vaatini mingivesenu.
konni chaala mannu leni raathinelanu padenu; akkada mannu lothugaa unda nanduna avi ventane molichenu gaani
sooryudu udayimpagaane avi maadi, verulenanduna endipoyenu.
konni mundlapodalalo padenu; mundlapodalu edigi vaatini anachivesenu ganuka avi phalimpaledu.
konni manchinelanu padenu; avi molichi perigi pairai muppadaṁ thalugaanu aruvadanthalugaanu nooranthalugaanu phalinchenu.
vinutaku chevulugalavaadu vinunugaaka ani cheppenu.
aayana ontarigaa unnappudu pandrendumandi shishyulathoo kooda aayanachuttu undinavaaru aa upamaanamunu goorchi aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana dhevuni raajya marmamu (telisikonuta) meeku anugrahimpabadiyunnadhi gaani

velupalanunduvaaru okavela dhevunivaipu thirigi paapa kshamaapana pondudurani, vaaru choochutakaithe chuchiyu kanugonakanu, vinutakaithe viniyu grahimpakayu nunduta kunu anniyu upamaanareethigaa vaariki bodhimpabaduchunna vani vaarithoo cheppenu
mariyu'ee upamaanamu meeku teliyaledaa? aalaagaithe upamaanamulanniyu meekelaagu teliyunanenu.
vitthuvaadu vaakyamu vitthu chunnaadu.
trovaprakka nundu vaarevaranagaa, vaakyamu vaarilo vitthabadunu gaani vaaru vinina ventane saathaanu vachi vaarilo vitthabadina vaakya metthikonipovunu.
atuvale raathinelanu vitthabadinavaarevaranagaa, vaakyamu vini santhooshamugaa angeekarinchuvaaru;
ayithe vaarilo veru lenanduna, konthakaalamu vaaru niluthuru gaani vaakyamu nimitthamu shramayainanu hinsayainanu kalugagaane vaaru abhyantharapaduduru.
itharulu mundlapodalalo vitthabadinavaaru;
veeru vaakyamu vinduru gaani aihika vichaaramulunu, dhanamosamunu mari itharamaina apekshalunu lopala cochi, vaakyamunu anachiveyuta valana adhi nishphalamagunu.
manchi nelanu vitthabadinavaarevaranagaa, vaakyamu vini, daanini angeekarinchi muppadanthalu gaanu aruvadanthalugaanu nooranthalugaanu phalinchuvaarani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo itlanenudeepamu deepa sthambhamumeeda nunchabadutake gaani kunchamu krindhanainanu manchamukrindhanaina nunchabadutaku thebadadu gadaa
rahasya medainanu thetaparachabadakapodu; bayaluparacha badutake gaani yediyu marugucheyabadaledu
vinutaku chevulevanikaina nundinayedala vaadu vinunugaakanenu.
mariyu aayana meeremi vinuchunnaaro jaagratthagaa choochukonudi. meeretti kolathathoo koluthuro meekunu atti kolathathoone koluvabadunu, mari ekkuvagaa mee kiyyabadunu.
kaliginavaaniki iyyabadunu, lenivaaniki kaliginadhiyu vaaniyoddhanundi theesiveyabadunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
mariyu aayana oka manushyudu bhoomilo vitthanamu challi,
raatrimbagallu nidrapovuchu, melkonuchu nundagaa, vaaniki teliyani reethigaa aa vitthanamu molichi periginatle dhevuni raajyamunnadhi.
bhoomi modata mola kanu tharuvaatha vennunu atutharuvaatha vennulo muduru ginjalanu thananthatathaane puttinchunu.
panta pandinappudu kothakaalamu vachinadani sedyagaadu ventane kodavali petti koyunani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana itlanenu dhevuni raajyamunu etlu polchedamu? e upamaanamuthoo daanini upaminchedamu?
adhi aavaginjanu poliyunnadhi. aavaginja bhoomilo vitthabadinappudu bhoomimeedanunna vitthanamulannitikante chinnadhe gaani
vitthabadina tharuvaatha adhi molichi yedigi koora mokkalannitikante peddadaigoppa kommalu veyunu ganuka aakaasha pakshulu daani needanu nivasimpagalavanenu.
vaariki vinutaku shakthi kaliginakoladhi yeelaati aneka maina upamaanamulanu cheppi, aayana vaariki vaakyamu bodhinchenu.
upamaanamu leka vaariki bodhimpaledu gaani ontarigaa unnappudu thana shishyulaku annitini vishadaparachenu.
aa diname saayankaalamainappudu aayana addariki povudamani vaarithoo cheppagaa,
vaaru janulanu pampivesi, aayananu unnapaatuna chinnadonelo theesikonipoyiri; aayanavembadi marikonni donelu vacchenu.
appudu pedda thupaanu regi aayana yunna donemeeda alalu kottinanduna done nindipoyenu.
aayana done amaramuna thalagadameeda (thala vaalchukoni) nidrinchuchundenu. Vaaraayananu lepi--bodhakudaa, memu nashinchipovu chunnaamu; neeku chinthaledaa? Ani aayanathoo aniri.
andukaayana lechi gaalini gaddinchi nishshabdamai oorakundu mani samudra muthoo cheppagaa, gaali anagi mikkili nimmala maayenu.
appudaayana meerenduku bhayapadu chunnaaru? meerinkanu nammikaleka yunnaaraa? Ani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru mikkili bhayapadi eeyana evaro, gaaliyu samudramunu eeyanaku lobadu chunnavani yokanithoo okadu cheppukoniri.
vaaraasamudramunaku addarinunna geraasenula dheshamunaku vachiri.
aayana done digagaane, apavitraatma pattinavaadokadu samaadhulalonundi vachi, aayana keduru padenu.
vaadu samaadhulalo vaasamu chesedivaadu, sankellathoonainanu evadunu vaani bandhimpa lekapoyenu.
palumaaru vaani kaallakunu chethulakunu sankellu vesi bandhinchinanu, vaadu aa chethisankellu tempi, kaalisankellanu thutthuniyalugaa chesenu ganuka evadunu vaanini saadhu parachalekapoyenu.
vaadu ellappudunu raatrimbagallu samaadhulalonu kondalalonu kekaluveyuchu, thannuthaanu raallathoo gaayaparachukonuchu nundenu.
vaadu dooramunundi yesunu chuchi, parugetthikonivachi, aayanaku namaskaaramuchesi
yesoo, sarvonnathudaina dhevunikumaarudaa, naathoo neekemi? Nannu baadhaparachakumani dhevuni perata neeku aanabettuchunnaanani biggaragaa kekalu vesenu.
endukanagaa aayana apavitraatmaa, yee manushyuni vidichi pommani vaanithoo cheppenu.
mariyu aayana nee peremani vaani nadugagaa vaadu naa peru sena, yyelayanagaa memu anekulamani cheppi
thammunu aa dheshamulonundi thooliveyavaddani aayananu migula bathimaalukonenu.
akkada kondadaggara pandula peddamanda meyuchundenu.
ganuka'aa pandulalo praveshinchunatlu mammunu vaatiyoddhaku pampumani, aa dayyamulu aayananu bathimaalukonenu.

yesu vaatiki selaviyyagaa aa apavitraatmalu vaanini vidichi pandulalo praveshinchenu. Praveshimpagaa inchuminchu rendu vela sankhyagala aa manda prapaathamunundi samudrapudaarini vadigaa parugetthikonipoyi, samudramulo padi oopiri thirugaka chacchenu.
aa pandulu mepuchunnavaaru paari poyi pattanamulonu graamamulalonu aa sangathi teliyajesiri.
janulu jariginadhi chooda velli yesunoddhaku vachi, sena anu dayyamulu pattinavaadu battalu dharinchu koni, svasthachitthudai koorchundiyunduta chuchi bhayapadiri.
jariginadhi chuchinavaaru dayyamulu pattinavaaniki kaligina sthithiyu pandula sangathiyu oorivaariki teliya jeyagaa
thama praanthamulu vidichipommani vaaraayananu bathimaalukonasaagiri.
aayana doneyekkinappudu, dayyamulu pattinavaadu aayanayoddha thannundanimmani aayananu bathimaalukonenu gaani
aayana vaaniki selaviyyaka neevu nee yintivaariyoddhaku velli, prabhuvu neeyandu kanikarapadi, neeku chesina kaaryamulannitini vaariki teliyajeppumanenu.
vaadu velli, yesu thanaku chesina vanniyu dekapolilo prakatimpa naarambhimpagaa andaru aashcharyapadiri.
yesu marala done yekki addariki vellinappudu bahu janasamoohamu aayanayoddhaku koodi vacchenu.
aayana samudratheeramuna nundagaa samaajamandirapu adhi kaarulalo yaayeeranu nokadu vachi, aayananu chuchi aayana paadamulameeda padi
naa chinnakumaarthe chaavanai yunnadhi; adhi baagupadi bradukunatlu neevu vachi daanimeeda nee chethulunchavalenani aayananu migula bathimaalukonagaa
aayana athanithoo kooda vellenu; bahu janasamoohamunu aayananu vembadinchi aayana meeda paduchundiri.
pandrendendlanundi rakthasraava rogamu kaligina yoka stree yundenu. aame aneka vaidyulachetha enno thippalupadi
thanaku kaliginadanthayu vyayamu chesikoni, yenthamaatramunu prayojanamuleka marintha sankata padenu.
aame yesunugoorchi vininenu aayana vastramulu maatramu muttina baagupadudunanukoni,
janasamoohamulo aayana venukaku vachi aayana vastramu muttenu.
ventane aame rakthadhaara kattenu ganuka thana shareeramuloni aabaadha nivaaranayainadani grahinchukonenu.
ventane yesu thanalonundi prabhaavamu bayaluvellenani thanalothaanu grahinchi, janasamoohamuvaipu thiriginaa vastramulu muttina devarani adugagaa
aayana shishyulu janasamoohamu nee meeda paduchunduta choochuchunnaave; nannu muttinadevadani aduguchunnaavaa? Aniri.
aa kaaryamu chesina aamenu kanugonavalenani aayana chuttu chuchenu.
appudaa stree thanaku jariginadhi yerigi, bhayapadi, vanakuchuvachi, aayana eduta saagilapadi, thana sangathi yanthayu aayanathoo cheppenu.
andukaayana kumaaree, nee vishvaasamu ninnu svasthapara chenu, samaadhaanamu galadaanavai pommu; nee baadha nivaaranayai neeku svasthatha kalugugaaka ani aamethoo cheppenu.
aayana inkanu maatalaaduchundagaa, samaajamandirapu adhikaari yintanundi kondaru vachinee kumaarthe chani poyinadhi; neevika bodhakuni enduku shrama pettuduvaniri.
yesu vaaru cheppinamaata lakshya pettakabhaya padakumu, nammika maatramunchumani samaaja mandirapu adhikaarithoo cheppi
pethuru, yaakobu, yaakobu sahodarudagu yohaanu anuvaarini thappa mari evari nainanu thana vembadi raaniyyaka
samaajamandirapu adhikaari yintiki vachi, vaaru gollugaanundi chaala yedchuchu, pralaapinchuchu nunduta chuchi
lopalikipoyi meerelagolluchesi yedchuchunnaaru? ee chinnadhi nidrinchu chunnadhegaani chanipoledani vaarithoo cheppenu.

anduku vaaru aayananu apahasinchiri. Ayithe aayana vaari nandarini bayataku pampivesi, aa chinnadaani thalidandrulanu thanathoo unnavaarini ventabettukoni, aa chinnadhi parundi yunna gadhiloniki velli
aa chinnadaani cheyipatti thaleethaakumee ani aamethoo cheppenu. aa maataku chinnadaanaa, lemmani neethoo cheppuchunnaanani arthamu.
ventane aa chinnadhi lechi nadavasaagenu; aame pandrendu samvatsaramula praayamu galadhi. Ventane vaaru bahugaa vismaya mondiri.
jariginadhi evaniki teliyakoodadani aayana vaariki gattigaa aagnaapinchi, aameku aahaaramu pettudani cheppenu.
aayana akkadanundi bayaludheri svadheshamunaku raagaa, aayana shishyulu aayananu vembadinchiri.

vishraanthi dinamu vachinappudu aayana samaajamandiramulo bodhimpanaarambhinchenu. Anekulu aayana bodha vini aashcharyapadi ee sangathulu ithaniki ekkadanundi vacchenu? Ithanikiyyabadina ee gnaanamettidi? Ithani chethula valana itti adbhuthamulu cheyabaduchunnavi? Idhemi?

ithadu mariya kumaarudu kaadaa? Ithadu yaakobu, yose, yoodhaa, seemonu anuvaari sahodarudagu vadlavaadu kaadaa? Ithani sodareemanulandaru manathoo nunnaaru kaaraa? Ani cheppu konuchu aayana vishayamai abhyantharapadiri.
anduku yesu pravaktha thana dheshamu lonu thana bandhuvulalonu thana yintivaarilonu thappa mari ekkadanu ghanaheenudu kaadani cheppenu.
andu valana koddimandi rogulameeda chethulunchi vaarini svastha parachuta thappa mari e adbhuthamunu aayana akkada cheyajaalakapoyenu. aayana vaari avishvaasamunaku aashcharyapadenu.
aayana chuttupatlanunna graamamulu thiruguchu bodhinchuchundenu.
aayana pandrenduguru shishyulanu thanayoddhaku pilichi, vaarini iddariddarinigaa pampuchu, apavitraatmala meeda vaari kadhikaaramichi
prayaanamukoraku chethikarranu thappa rottenainanu jaalenainanu sanchilo sommunainanu theesikonaka
cheppulu thodagukonudaniyu, rendangeelu vesikona vaddaniyu vaarikaagnaapinchenu.
mariyu aayana vaarithoo itlanenumeerekkada oka yinta praveshinchedaro akkadanundi meeru bayaludheruvaraku aa yintane basacheyudi.
e sthalamandainanu janulu mimmunu cherchu konaka mee maatalu vinakunte, meeru akkadanundi bayaludherunappudu vaarimeeda saakshyamugaa undutaku mee paadamula krindi dhooli dulipiveyudi.
kaagaa vaaru bayaludheri, maarumanassu pondavalenani praka tinchuchu
aneka dayyamulu vellagottuchu nooneraachi anekulagu rogulanu svasthaparachuchunundiri.

aayana keerthi prasiddhamaayenu ganuka raajaina herodu aayananugoorchi vinibaapthismamichu yohaanu mruthulalonundi lechiyunnaadu ganuka athaniyandu adbhutha mulu kriyaaroopakamulaguchunnavani cheppenu.
itharulu eeyana eleeyaa aniyu, marikondaru'eeyana pravakthayaniyu, pravakthalalo okanivale nunnaadaniyu cheppukonuchundiri.
ayithe herodu vininenu thala gottinchina yohaane; athadu mruthulalonundi lechi yunnaadani cheppenu.
herodu thana sahodarudagu philippu bhaaryayaina herodiyanu pendlichesikoninanduna yohaanunee sahodaruni bhaaryanu cherchukonuta neeku nyaayamu kaadani heroduthoo cheppenu ganuka
itha daame nimitthamu yohaanunu patti teppinchi, cherasaalalo bandhinchiyundenu.
herodiya athani meeda pagapatti athani champimpa gorenu gaani aamechetha gaakapoyenu.

endukanagaa yohaanu neethimanthudunu parishuddhudunagu manushyudani herodu erigi, athaniki bhayapadi athani kaapaaduchu vacchenu. Mariyu athani maatalu vini nappudu, emicheyanu thoochakapoyinanu santhooshamuthoo vinuchundenu.
ayithe thagina dinamokati vacchenu; etlanagaa, herodu thana janana dinotsavamandu thana pradhaanulakunu sahasraadhipathulakunu galilayadhesha pramukhulakunu vindu cheyinchenu.

appudu herodiya kumaarthe lopaliki vachi naatyamaadi herodunu athanithoo kooda pankthini koorchunnavaarini santhooshaparachenu ganuka raajuneekishtamainadhi edainanu nannadugumu, nenu neekicchedhanani aa chinnadaanithoo cheppenu
mariyu-neevu naa raajyamulo sagamumattuku emi adiginanu neekicchedhanani athadu aamethoo ottupettukonenu
ganuka aame velli-nenemi adigedhanani thana thalli nadugagaa aame baapthismamichu yohaanu thala adugumanenu.
ventane aame tvaragaa raajunoddhaku vachi-baapthismamichu yohaanu thala pallemulo pettiyippude naakippimpa goruchunnaanani cheppenu.
raaju bahugaa duḥkhapadenu gaani thaanu pettukonina ottu nimitthamunu thanathoo koorchundiyunna vaari nimitthamunu aameku iyyanu ananollaka poyenu.
ventane raaju athani thala temmani aagnaapinchi yoka bantrauthunu pampenu. Vaadu velli cherasaalalo athani thala gotti
pallemulo athani thala petti techi aa chinna daani kicchenu, aa chinnadhi thana thallikicchenu.
yohaanu shishyulu ee sangathi vini, vachi shavamunu etthikonipoyi samaadhilo unchiri.
anthata aposthalulu yesunoddhaku koodivachi thaamu chesinavanniyu bodhinchinavanniyu aayanaku teliya jesiri.

appudaayana meerekaanthamugaa aranya pradhesha munaku vachi, konchemusepu alasata theerchukonudani cheppenu; yelayanagaa anekulu vachuchu povuchu nundi nanduna, bhojanamu cheyutakainanu vaariki avakaashamu lekapoyenu.
kaagaa vaaru done yekki aranya pradheshamunaku ekaanthamugaa velliri.
vaaru velluchundagaa janulu chuchi, anekulaayananu gurterigi, sakala pattanamula nundi akkadiki kaalinadakanu parugetthi vaarikante mundhugaa vachiri.
ganuka yesu vachi aa goppa jana samoohamunu chuchi, vaaru kaaparileni gorrelavale unnanduna vaarimeeda kanikarapadi, vaariki aneka sangathu lanu bodhimpa saagenu.
chaala proddupoyina tharuvaatha aayana shishyu laayanayoddhaku vachi'idi aranya pradheshamu, ippudu chaala proddupoyinadhi;
chuttupatla pradhesha mulakunu graamamulakunu vaaru velli bhojanamuna kemainanu konukkonutaku vaarini pampi veyumani cheppiri.
andukaayana meeru vaariki bhojanamu pettudanagaa vaarumemu velli yeennooru dhenaaramula rottelu koni vaariki pettudumaa ani aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana meeyoddha enni rotte lunnavi? Poyi choodudanivaarithoo cheppenu. Vaaru chuchi telisikoni ayidu rottelunu rendu chepalu nunnavaniri.
appudaayana pachikameeda andaru pankthulu pankthulugaa koorchundavalenani vaarikaagnaapimpagaa
vaaru nooresi mandi choppunanu ebadhesimandi choppunanu pankthulu theeri koorchundiri.

anthata aayana aa ayidu rottelanu rendu chepalanu pattukoni, aakaashamuvaipu kannuletthi aasheervadhinchi, aa rottelu virichi, vaariki vaddinchutaku thana shishyulakichi, aa rendu chepalanu andarikini panchi
vaarandaru thini trupthi pondina
tharuvaatha migilina chepalunu rotte mukkalunu pandrendu gampellu etthiri.
aa rottelu thininavaaru ayiduvelamandi purushulu.
aayana janasamoohamunu pampiveyunanthalo, done ekki addarinunna betsayidaaku mundhugaa velludani aayana thana shishyulanu ventane balavanthamu chesenu.
aayana vaarini veedukolipi, praarthanacheyutaku kondaku vellenu.
saayankaalamainappudu aa done samudramu madhya undenu aayana ontarigaa metta nundenu.

appudu vaariki gaali edurainanduna, done nadipinchutalo vaaru mikkili kashtapaduchundagaa aayana chuchi, raatri inchu minchu naalugava jaamuna samudramumeeda naduchuchu vaariyoddhaku vachi, vaarini daatipovalenani yundenu.
aayana samudramumeeda naduchuta vaaru chuchi, bhootha mani thalanchi kekalu vesiri.
andaru aayananu chuchi tondharapadagaa, ventane aayana vaarini palukarinchi dhairyamu techu konudi, nene, bhayapadakudani cheppenu.
tharuvaatha aayana done yekki vaariyoddhaku vachinappudu gaali anagenu, anduku vaaru thamalothaamu mikkili vibhraanthi nondiri;
ayinanu vaari hrudayamu kathina maayenu ganuka vaaru rottelanugoorchina sangathi grahimpaledu.
vaaru avathalaku velli gennesarethu daggara odduku vachi dari pattiri.
vaaru done digagaane, janulu aayananu guruthupatti
aa pradheshamandanthata parugetthikonipoyi, aayana yunnaadani vininachootunaku rogulanu manchamula meeda mosikoni vachutaku modalupettiri.

graamamula lonu pattanamulalonu palletoollalonu aayana yekka dekkada praveshincheno akkadi janulu rogulanu santha veethulalo unchi, vaarini aayana vastrapuchengumaatramu muttanimmani aayananu vedukonuchundiri. aayananu muttina vaarandaru svasthathanondiri.
yerooshalemunundi vachina parisayyulunu shaastrulalo kondarunu aayanayoddhaku koodivachi
aayana shishyulalo kondaru apavitramaina chethulathoo, anagaa kadugani chethulathoo bhojanamu cheyuta chuchiri.
pari sayyulunu yoodulandarunu peddala paaramparyaachaaramunubatti chethulu kadugukontene gaani bhojanamu cheyaru.

mariyu vaaru santhanundi vachinappudu neellu challukontene gaani bhojanamu cheyaru. Idiyugaaka ginnelanu kundalanu itthadi paatralanu neellalo kaduguta modalagu anekaachaaramulanu vaaranusarinchedivaaru.
appudu parisayyulunu shaastrulunu nee shishyulenduku peddala paaramparyaachaaramuchoppuna naduchukonaka, apavitramaina chethulathoo bhojanamu cheyudurani aayana nadi giri.
andukaayana vaarithoo eelaagu cheppenu ee prajalu pedavulathoo nannu ghanaparachudurugaani, vaari hrudayamu naaku dooramugaa unnadhi.
vaaru, maanavulu kalpinchina paddhathulu dhevopa dheshamulani bodhinchuchu nannu vyarthamugaa aaraadhinchuduru ani vraayabadinattu veshadhaarulaina mimmunugoorchi yeshayaa pravachinchinadhi sariye.
meeru dhevuni aagnanu vidichipetti, manushyula paaramparyaachaaramunu gaikonu chunnaaru.
mariyu aayana meeru mee paaramparyaa chaaramunu gaikonutaku dhevuni aagnanu botthigaa niraaka rinchuduru.
nee thalidandrulanu ghanaparachavalenaniyu, thandrinainanu thallinainanu dooshinchuvaaniki maranashiksha vidhimpavalenaniyu moshe cheppenu gadaa.
ayinanu meeru okadu thana thandrinainanu thallinainanu chuchi naavalana neeku prayojanamagunadhi edo adhi korbaanu, anagaa dhevaarpithamani cheppinayedala,
thana thandrikainanu thalli kainanu vaanini emiyu cheyaniyyaka
meeru niya minchina mee paaramparyaachaaramuvalana dhevuni vaakyamunu nirarthakamu cheyuduru. Ituvantivi anekamulu meeru cheyudurani cheppenu.
appudaayana janasamoohamunu marala thanayoddhaku pilichimeerandaru naa maata vini grahinchudi.
velupalinundi lopaliki poyi manushyuni apavitrunigaa cheyagalugunadhi ediyu ledu gaani,
lopalinundi bayalu vellunave manushyuni apavitrunigaa cheyunanenu.
aayana janasamoohamunu vidichi yinti loniki vachinappudu, aayana shishyulu ee upamaanamunu goorchi aayana nadugagaa
aayana vaarithoo itlanenumeerunu intha avivekulai yunnaaraa? Velupalinundi manushyuni lopaliki povunadhediyu vaani napavitrunigaa cheyajaaladani meeru grahimpakunnaaraa?
adhi vaani hrudayamulo praveshimpaka kadupulone praveshinchi bahirboomilo viduvabadunu; itlu adhi bhojanapadaarthamu lanni tini pavitraparachunu.
manushyuni lopalinundi bayalu vellunadhi manushyuni apavitraparachunu.
lopalinundi, anagaa manushyula hrudayamulonundi duraalochanalunu jaaratvamulunu dongathanamulunu
narahatyalunu vyabhi chaaramulunu lobhamulunu cheduthanamulunu krutrima munu kaamavikaaramunu matsaramunu dhevadooshanayu ahambhaavamunu avivekamunu vachunu.
ee cheddavanniyu lopalinundiye bayaluvelli, manushyuni apavitra parachunani aayana cheppenu.
aayana akkadanundi lechi, thooru seedonula praantha mulaku velli, yoka inta praveshinchi, aa sangathi evanikini teliyakundavalenani korenu gaani aayana marugai yunda leka poyenu.
apavitraatma pattina chinnakumaarthegala yoka stree aayananugoorchi vini, ventane vachi aayana paadamulameeda padenu.
aa stree surophenikaya vansha mandu puttina greesu dheshasthuraalu. aame thana kumaarthelonundi aa dayyamunu vellagottumani aayananu vedu konenu.
aayana aamenu chuchipillalu modata trupthi pondavalenu; pillala rotte theesikoni kukkapillalaku veyuta yukthamu kaadanenu.
andukaamenijame prabhuvaa, ayithe kukkapillalu kooda ballakrinda undi, pillalu padaveyu rottemukkalu thinunu gadaa ani aayanathoo cheppenu.
andukaayana ee maata cheppinanduna vellumu; dayyamu nee kumaarthenu vadalipoyinadani aamethoo cheppenu.
aame yintiki vachi, thana kumaarthe manchamumeeda pandukoni yundutayu dayyamu vadali poyi yundutayu chuchenu.
aayana marala thooru praanthamulu vidichi, seedonu dvaaraa dekapoli praanthamulameedugaa galilaya samudramunoddhaku vacchenu.
appudu vaaru chevudugala natthi vaani okani aayanayoddhaku thoodukonivachi, vaanimeeda cheyyi yunchumani aayananu vedukoniri.
samooha mulonundi aayana vaanini ekaanthamunaku thoodukoni poyi, vaani chevulalo thana vrellupetti, ummivesi, vaani naaluka mutti
aakaashamuvaipu kannuletthi nittoorpu vidichi epphathaa ani vaanithoo cheppenu; aa maataku teravabadumani arthamu.
anthata vaani chevulu teravabadenu, vaani naaluka naramu sadali vaadu thetagaa maatalaaduchundenu.
appudaayana idi evanithoonu cheppavaddani vaari kaagnaa pinchenu; ayithe aayana cheppavaddani vaari kaagnaapinchina koladhi vaaru mari ekkuvagaa daanini prasiddhicheyuchu
eeyana samasthamunu baagugaa chesiyunnaadu; cheviti vaaru vinunatlugaanu moogavaaru maatalaadunatlugaanu cheyuchunnaadani cheppukoni aparimithamugaa aashcharyapadiri.
aa dinamulalo mariyoka saari bahu janulu koodi raagaa, vaariki thinanemiyu lenanduna yesu thana shishyu lanu thanayoddhaku pilichi
janulu netiki moodu dinamula nundi naayoddhanunnaaru; vaariki thinanemiyu lenanduna, nenu vaarimeeda kanikarapaduchunnaanu;
nenu vaarini upavaasamuthoo thama indlaku pampivesinayedala maargamulo moorchapovuduru; vaarilo kondaru dooramunundi vachiyunnaarani vaarithoo cheppenu.
andukaayana shishyulu ee aranyapradheshamulo oka dekkada nundi rottelu techi, veerini trupthiparachagaladani aayana nadigiri.
aayanameeyoddha enni rottelunnavani vaarinadugagaa vaaru'edaniri.

appudaayananelameeda koorchundudani janulakaagnaapinchi aa yedu rottelu pattukoni kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchi, virichi, vaddinchutakai thana shishyulakicchenu, vaaru janasamoohamunaku vaddinchiri
konni chinnachepalu kooda vaariyoddhanundagaa aayana aasheervadhinchi vaatinikooda vaddinchudani cheppenu.
vaaru bhojanamuchesi trupthipondinameedata, migilina mukkalu edu gampalaninda etthiri.
bhojanamu chesinavaaru inchu minchu naalugu vela mandi. Vaarini pampivesina ventane
aayana thana shishyulathookooda done yekki dalmanoothaa praanthamulaku vacchenu.
anthata parisayyulu vachi aayananu shodhinchuchu, aakaashamunundi yoka soochakakriyanu choopumani aayana nadigi aayanathoo tharkimpasaagiri.
aayana aatmayandu pedda nittoorpu vidichi ee tharamuvaaru enduku soochaka kriya naduguchunnaaru? ee tharamunaku e soochaka kriyayu nanugrahimpabadadani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanani cheppi
vaarini vidichi marala doneyekki addariki poyenu.
vaaru thinutaku rottelu techutaku marachiri; donelo vaariyoddha okka rotte thappa maremiyu lekapoyenu.
aayanachoochukonudi; parisayyula pulisina pindini goorchiyu herodu pulisina pindinigoorchiyu jaagrattha padudani vaarini heccharimpagaa
vaaruthamayoddha rottelu leveyani thamalo thaamu aalochinchukoniri.
yesu adhi yerigimanayoddha rottelu leveyani meerenduku aalochinchukonuchunnaaru? meerinkanu grahimpaledaa? Vivechimpaledaa? meeru kathinahrudayamu galavaarai yunnaaraa?
meeru kannulundiyu choodaraa? chevulundiyu vinaraa? gnaapakamu chesikonaraa?
nenu aa ayiduvelamandiki ayidu rottelu virichi panchipetti nappudu meeru mukkalu enni gampalaninda etthithirani vaari nadigenu. Vaarupandrendani aayanathoo cheppiri.
aa naalugu velamandiki edu rottelu nenu virichi, panchi pettinappudu mukkalu enni gampalaninda etthithirani aayana adugagaa vaaru'edaniri.
andukaayana meerinkanu grahimpakunnaaraa? Ani anenu.
anthalo vaaru betsayidaaku vachiri. Appudu akkadi vaaru aayanayoddhaku oka gruddivaani thoodu konivachi, vaani muttavalenani aayananu vedukoniri.
aayana aa gruddivaani cheyyipattukoni oorivelupaliki thoodukoni poyi, vaani kannulameeda ummivesi, vaanimeeda chethulunchineekemainanu kanabaduchunnadaa? Ani vaaninadugagaa,
vaadu kannuletthi manushyulu naaku kanabaduchunnaaru; vaaru chetlavalenundi naduchu chunnatlugaa naaku kanabaduchunnaaranenu.
anthata aayana marala thana chethulu vaani kannulameeda nunchagaa, vaadu therichuchi kudurchabadi samasthamunu thetagaa chooda saagenu.
appudu yesu neevu ooriloniki vellavaddani cheppi vaani yintiki vaanini pampivesenu.
yesu thana shishyulathoo philippudaina kaisarayathoo cherina graamamulaku bayaludherenu. Maargamulonundagaa nenu evadanani janulu cheppuchunnaarani thana shishyula nadigenu.
anduku vaaru kondaru baapthismamichu yohaanu aniyu, kondaru eleeyaa aniyu, mari kondaru pravakthalalo okadaniyu cheppu konuchunnaaraniri.
andukaayana meeraithe nenu evadani cheppuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa pethuruneevu kreesthu vani aayanathoo cheppenu.
appudu thannu goorchina yee sangathi evani thoonu cheppavaddani aayana vaariki khandithamugaa cheppenu.

mariyu manushyakumaarudu aneka hinsalupondi, peddala chethanu pradhaanayaajakula chethanu shaastrulachethanu upekshimpa badi champabadi, moodu dinamulaina tharuvaatha lechuta agatyamani aayana vaariki bodhimpa naarambhinchenu.
aayana ee maata bahirangamugaa cheppenu. Pethuru aayana cheyipattukoni aayananu gaddimpasaagenu

andukaayana thana shishyulavaipu thirigi, vaarini chuchi saathaanaa, naa venukaku pommu; neevu manushyula sangathulanu manaskarinchuchunnaavu gaani dhevuni sangathulanu manaskarimpakunnaavani pethurunu gaddhinchenu
anthata aayana thana shishyulanu janasamoohamunu thana yoddhaku pilichinannu vembadimpa goruvaadu thannuthaanu upekshinchukoni thana siluvayettthi koni nannu vemba dimpavalenu.
thana praanamunu rakshinchukonagoruvaadu daani pogottukonunu; naa nimitthamunu suvaartha nimitthamunu thana praanamunu pogottukonuvaadu daani rakshinchu konunu.
okadu sarvalokamunu sampaadhinchukoni thana praanamunu pogottukonuta vaanikemi prayojanamu?
manushyudu thana praanamunaku prathigaa emi iyyagalugunu?

vyabhichaaramunu paapamunucheyu ee tharamu vaarilo nannu goorchiyu naamaatalanugoorchiyu siggupadu vaadevado, vaaninigoorchi manushyakumaarudu thana thandri mahimagalavaadai parishuddha doothalathookooda vachunappudu siggupadunani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana ikkada nilichiyunna vaarilo kondaru dhevuniraajyamu balamuthoo vachuta choochuvaraku maranamu ruchichoodarani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppu chunnaananenu.
aarudinamulaina tharuvaatha, yesu pethurunu yaakobunu yohaanunu maatramu ventabettukoni, yetthayina yoka kondameediki ekaanthamugaa vaarini thoodukonipoyi, vaariyeduta roopaantharamu pondhenu.
anthalo aayana vastramulu prakaashamaanamainaviyu migula tellaniviyu aayenu; lokamandu e chaakaliyunu antha tellagaa chaluvacheyaledu.
mariyu mosheyu eleeyaayu vaariki kanabadi yesuthoo maatalaaduchundiri.
appudu pethuru bodhakudaa, manamikkada unduta manchidi; memu neeku okatiyu mosheku okatiyu eleeyaaku okatiyu moodu parnashaalalu kattudumani cheppenu;
vaaru migula bhayapadiri ganuka thaanu cheppavalasinadhemo athaniki teliyaledu.
meghamokati vachi vaarini kammagaa eeyana naa priyakumaarudu, eeyana maata vinudani yoka shabdamu aa meghamulonundi puttenu.
ventane vaaru chuttu chuchinappudu, thama yoddhanunna yesu thappa mari evarunu vaariki kanabadaledu.
vaaru aa konda digi vachuchundagaa manushya kumaarudu mruthulalonundi lechinappude gaani, anthaku mundu meeru chuchinavaatini evanithoonu cheppavaddani aayana vaariki aagnaapinchenu.
mruthulalonundi lechuta anagaa emito ani vaarokanithoo okadu tharkinchuchu aa maata manassuna unchukoniri.
vaaru eleeyaa mundhugaa raavalenani shaastrulu cheppuchunnaare,yidhemani aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana eleeyaa mundhugaa vachi samasthamunu chakka pettunanu maata nijame; ayinanu manushyakumaarudu aneka shramalupadi, truneekarimpabada valenani vraayabaduta emi?
eleeyaa vacchenaniyu athanigoorchi vraayabadina prakaaramu vaaru thamakishtamu vachinattu athaniyedala chesiraniyu meethoo cheppu chunnaanani vaarithoo anenu.
vaaru shishyulayoddhaku vachi, vaari chuttu bahu janulu koodiyundutayu shaastrulu vaarithoo tharkinchutayu chuchiri.
ventane janasamoohamanthayu aayananu chuchi, migula vibhraanthinondi aayanayoddhaku parugetthi konivachi aayanaku vandhanamuchesiri.
appudaayanameeru dhenigoorchi vaarithoo tharkinchuchunnaarani vaari nadugagaa
janasamoohamulo okadubodhakudaa, moogadayyamu pattina naa kumaaruni neeyoddhaku theesikoni vachithini;

adhi ekkada vaanini pattuno akkada vaanini padadroyunu; appudu vaadu nurugu kaarchukoni, pandlu korukukoni moorchillunu; daanini vellagottudani nee shishyulanu adigithini gaani adhi vaarichetha kaaledani aayanathoo cheppenu.
andukaayana vishvaasamuleni tharamuvaaralaaraa, nenu enthakaalamu meethoo nundunu? Enthavaraku mimmunu sahinthunu? Vaanini naayoddhaku theesikoni randani vaarithoo cheppagaa
vaaraayanayoddhaku vaanini theesikoni vachiri. Dayyamu aayananu chooda gaane, vaani vilavila laadinchenu ganuka vaadu nelapadi nurugu kaarchukonuchu porlaaduchundenu.
appudaayana idi veeniki sambhavinchi yenthakaalamainadani vaani thandri nadugagaa athadu baalyamunundiye;
adhi vaani naashanamu cheyavalenani tharachugaa agnilonu neellalonu padadroyunu. emainanu neevalananaithe maameeda kanikarapadi maaku sahaayamu cheyumanenu.
anduku yesu (nammuta) neevalananaithe, nammuvaaniki samasthamunu saadhyame yani athanithoo cheppenu.
ventane aa chinnavaani thandrinammuchunnaanu, naaku apanammakamundakunda sahaayamu cheyumani biggaragaa cheppenu.

janulu gumpukoodi thanayoddhaku paru getthikonivachuta yesu chuchi moogavaina cheviti dayyamaa, vaanini vadhilipommu, ika vaanilopraveshimpavaddani neeku aagnaapinchuchunnaanani cheppi aa apavitraatmanu gaddinchenu.
appudu adhi kekavesi, vaaninenthoo vilavila laadinchi vadalipoyenu. Anthata vaadu chachinavaanivale undenu ganuka anekuluvaadu chanipoyenaniri.
ayithe yesu vaani cheyyi pattivaani levanetthagaa vaadu niluvabadenu.
aayana inti loniki vellina tharuvaatha aayana shishyulume menduku aa dayyamunu vellagottaleka pothimani ekaanthamuna aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana praarthanavalanane gaani mari dhenivalananainanu ee vidhamainadhi vadalipovuta asaadhyamani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaarakkadanundi bayaludheri galilaya gundaa vellu chundiri; adhi evanikini teliyuta aayanakishtamuleka poyenu;

yelayanagaa aayana thana shishyulaku bodhinchuchu manushyakumaarudu manushyula chethiki appagimpabadu chunnaadu, vaaraayananu champedaru; champabadina moodu dinamulaku aayana lechunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru aa maata grahimpaledu gaani aayana naduga bhayapadiri.
anthata vaaru kapernahoomunaku vachiri. Vaaru evadu goppavaadani maargamuna okanithoo okadu vaadhinchiri ganuka
aayana inta unnappudu maargamuna meeru okarithoo okaru dheninigoorchi vaadhinchuchuntirani vaarinadugagaa
vaaru oorakundiri. Appudaayana koorchundi pandrendumandhini pilichi'evadainanu modati vaadaiyunda gorinayedala, vaadandarilo kadapativaadunu andariki parichaarakudunai yundavalenani cheppi
yoka chinna biddanu theesikoni vaari madhyanu niluvabetti, vaanini etthi kaugilinchukoni
itti chinna biddalalo okanini naa perata cherchukonuvaadu nannu cherchukonunu; nannu cherchukonuvaadu nannu gaaka nannu pampinavaanini cherchu konunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anthata yohaanubodhakudaa, okadu nee perata dayyamulanu vellagottuta chuchithivi; vaadu manalanu vembadinchuvaadu kaadu ganuka vaanini aatankaparachithimani cheppenu.
anduku yesuvaanini aatankaparachakudi; naaperata adbhuthamu chesi nannu chulakanagaa nindimpagala vaadevadunu ledu;
manaku virodhikaanivaadu mana pakshamugaa nunnavaade.
meeru kreesthuvaarani naa perata meeku ginnedu neellu traaganichuvaadu, thanaku raavalasina phalamu pogottukonadani meethoonishchayamugaa cheppu chunnaanu.
naayandu vishvaasamunchu ee chinnavaarilo nokani abhyantharaparachuvaadevado, vaadu medaku pedda thirugatiraayi kattabadi samudramulo padaveyabaduta vaaniki melu.
nee cheyyi ninnu abhyantharaparachina yedala daanini narikiveyumu;
neevu rendu chethulu kaligi narakamuloni aarani agniloniki povutakante anga heenudavai jeevamulo praveshinchuta melu.
nee paadamu ninnu abhyantharaparachinayedala daanini narikiveyumu;
rendu paadamulu kaligi narakamulo padaveyabadutakante, kuntivaadavai (nitya) jeevamulo praveshinchutamelu.
neekannu ninnu abhyantharaparachinayedala daani theesipaara veyumu; rendu kannulu kaligi narakamulo padaveya badutakante ontikannu galavaadavai dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchuta melu.
narakamuna vaari purugu chaavadu;agni aaradu.
prathivaaniki uppusaaramu agnivalana kalugunu.
uppu manchidhegaani uppu nissaaramaina yedala dhenivalana meeru daaniki saaramu kalugujethuru? meelo meeru uppusaaramu galavaarai yundi yokarithoo okaru samaadhaanamugaa undudani cheppenu.
aayana akkadanundi lechi yoodaya praanthamulakunu yordaanu addarikini vacchenu. Janasamoohamulu thirigi aayanayoddhaku koodivachiri. aayana thana vaaduka choppuna vaariki marala bodhinchuchundenu.
parisayyulu aayanayoddhaku vachi, aayananu shodhinchutakaipurushudu thana bhaaryanu vidanaaduta nyaayamaa? Ani aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana moshe meekemi aagnaapinchenani vaarinadigenu.
vaaruparityaaga patrika vraayinchi, aamenu vidanaadavalenani moshe selavicchenani cheppagaa
yesumee hrudayakaathinyamunu batti athadee aagnanu meeku vraasi yicchenu gaani
srushtyaadhinundi (dhevudu) vaarini puru shunigaanu streenigaanu kaluga jesenu.
ee hethuvuchetha purushudu thana thalidandrulanu vidichi petti thana bhaaryanu hatthukonunu;
vaariddaru ekashareeramai yunduru, ganuka vaarika iddarugaa nundaka yekashareeramugaa nunduru.
kaabatti dhevudu jathaparachina vaarini manushyudu veruparacha koodadani vaarithoo cheppenu.
intiki vachi shishyulu ee sangathinigoorchi aayananu marala nadigiri.
andukaayana thana bhaaryanu vidanaadi mariyokatenu pendlichesikonuvaadu thaanu vidanaadina aame vishayamai vyabhicharinchuvaadagunu.
mariyu stree thana purushuni vidanaadi mariyokani pendlijesikoninayedala aame vyabhicharinchunadagunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
thama chinnabiddalanu muttavalenani kondharaayanayoddhaku vaarini theesikoni vachiri; ayithe shishyulu (vaarini theesikoni vachina) vaarini gaddinchiri.
yesu adhi chuchi kopapadichinnabiddalanu naayeddaku raaniyyudi, vaari naatanka parachavaddu; dhevuniraajyamu eelaativaaridhe.
chinnabiddavale dhevuniraajyamu nangeekarimpanivaadu andulo nentha maatramu praveshimpadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppu chunnaanani cheppi
aa biddalanu etthi kaugilinchukoni, vaari meeda chethulunchi aasheervadhinchenu.
aayana bayaludheri maargamuna povuchundagaa okadu parugetthikonivachi aayanayeduta mokaalloonisadbodha kudaa, nityajeevamunaku vaarasudanagutaku nenemi cheyudunani aayana nadigenu.
yesunannu satpurushudani yela cheppuchunnaavu? dhevudokkade gaani mari evadunu satpurushudu kaadu.
narahatya cheyavaddu, vyabhicha rimpavaddu, dongilavaddu, abaddhasaakshyamu palukavaddu, mosa pucchavaddu, nee thalidandrulanu sanmaanimpumu anu aagnalu neeku teliyunu gadaa ani athanithoo cheppenu.
andu kathadubodhakudaa, baalyamunundi ivanniyu anusa rinchuchune yuntinani cheppenu.

yesu athani chuchi athani preminchineeku okati koduvagaanunnadhi; neevu velli neeku kaliginavanniyu ammi beedalakimmu, paralokamandu neeku dhanamu kalugunu; neevu vachi nannu vembadinchumani cheppenu.
athadu migula aasthigalavaadu, ganuka aa maataku mukhamu chinnabuchukoni, duḥkhapaduchu vellipoyenu.
appudu yesu chuttu chuchi'aasthigalavaaru dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchuta enthoo durlabhamani thana shishyu lathoo cheppenu.
aayana maatalaku shishyulu vismaya mondiri. Anduku yesu thirigi vaarithoo itlanenu pillalaaraa, thama aasthiyandu nammikayunchuvaaru dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchuta enthoo durlabhamu;
dhanavanthudu dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchutakante onte soodibejjamulo dooruta sulabhamu.
anduku vaaru atyadhikamugaa aashcharyapadi atlayithe evadu rakshanaponda galadani aayana nadigiri.
yesu vaarini chuchi idi manu shyulaku asaadhyame gaani, dhevuniki asaadhyamu kaadu; dhevuniki samasthamunu saadhyame anenu.
pethuru idigo memu samasthamunu vidichipetti ninnu vembadinchithimani aayanathoo cheppasaagenu.
anduku yesu itlanenu naa nimitthamunu suvaartha nimitthamunu intinainanu annadammulanainanu akka chellendranainanu thalidandrulanainanu pillalanainanu bhoomulanainanu vidichinavaadu

ippudu ihamandu hinsalathoo paatu nooranthalugaa indlanu annadammulanu akkachellendranu thallulanu pillalanu bhoomulanu, raabovu lokamandu nityajeevamunu pondu nani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
modati vaaru anekulu kadapativaaraguduru, kadapativaaru modati vaaraguduru anenu.

vaaru prayaanamai yerooshalemunaku velluchundiri. Yesu vaariki mundu naduchuchundagaa vaaru vismaya mondiri, vembadinchuvaaru bhayapadiri. Appudaayana marala pandrenduguru shishyulanu piluchukoni, thanaku sambhavimpabovuvaatini vaariki teliyajeppanaarambhinchi
idigo manamu yerooshalemunaku velluchunnaamu; manushya kumaarudu pradhaanayaajakulakunu shaastrulakunu appagimpa badunu; vaaraayanaku maranashiksha vidhinchi aayananu anya janula kappaginchedaru.
vaaru aayananu apahasinchi, aayana meeda ummivesi, koradaalathoo aayananu kotti champedaru; moodu dinamulaina tharuvaatha aayana thirigi lechunani cheppenu.
jebedayi kumaarulaina yaakobunu yohaanunu aayanayoddhaku vachibodhakudaa, memu adugunadella neevu maaku cheya goruchunnaamani cheppagaa
aayananenu meekemi cheya goruchunnaarani vaari nadigenu.
vaarunee mahimayandu nee kudivaipuna okadunu nee yedamavaipuna okadunu koorchundunatlu maaku daya cheyumani cheppiri.
yesumeeremi aduguchunnaaro meeku teliyadu; nenu traaguchunna ginnelonidi traagutayainanu, nenu ponduchunna baapthismamu pondutayainanu meechetha agunaa? Ani vaari nadugagaa vaarumaachetha agunaniri.
appudu yesunenu traaguchunna ginnelonidi meeru traagedaru; nenu ponduchunna baapthi smamu meeru pondedaru, gaani
naa kudivaipunanu edama vaipunanu koorchundanichuta naavashamulo ledu; adhi evariki siddhaparachabadeno vaarike (dorakunani) vaarithoo cheppenu.
thakkinapadhimandi shishyulu aa maata vini, yaakobu yohaanula meeda kopapadasaagiri.

yesu vaarini thanayoddhaku pilichi vaarithoo itlanenu anyajanulalo adhikaarulani yenchabadinavaaru vaarimeeda prabhutvamu cheyuduru; vaarilo goppavaaru vaarimeeda adhikaaramu cheyudurani meeku teliyunu.
meelo aalaagunda koodadu. meelo evadainanu goppavaadai yundagorina yedala vaadu meeku parichaaramu cheyuvaadai yunda valenu.
meelo evadainanu pramukhudai yundagorina yedala, vaadu andariki daasudai yundavalenu.
manushya kumaarudu parichaaramu cheyinchukonutaku raaledu gaani parichaaramu cheyutakunu, anekulaku prathigaa vimochana krayadhanamugaa thana praanamu ichutakunu vacchenanenu.

vaaru yeriko pattanamunaku vachiri. aayana thana shishyulathoonu bahu janasamoohamuthoonu yerikonundi bayaludheri vachuchundagaa, theemayi kumaarudagu barthimayiyanu gruddi bhikshakudu trovaprakkanu koorchundenu.
eeyana najareyudaina yesu ani vaadu vini daaveedu kumaarudaa yesoo, nannu karunimpumani kekalu veya modalupettenu.
oorakundumani anekulu vaanini gaddinchiri gaani vaadu daaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karu nimpumani mari ekkuvagaa kekaluvesenu.
appudu yesu nilichivaanini piluvudani cheppagaa vaaraa gruddivaanini pilichi dhairyamu techukonumu, aayana ninnu piluchu chunnaadu, lemmani vaanithoo cheppiri.
anthata vaadu battanu paaravesi, digguna lechi yesunoddhaku vacchenu.
yesu - nenu neekemi cheya goruchunnaavani vaani nadugagaa, aa gruddivaadu bodhakudaa - naaku drushti kalugajeyumani aayanathoo anenu.
anduku yesu neevu vellumu; nee vishvaasamu ninnu svasthaparachenani cheppenu. Ventane vaadu trovanu aayanaventa choopupondivellenu.
vaaru yerooshalemunaku sameepinchi oleevala konda daggaranunna betpage bethaniya anu graamamulaku vachi nappudu, aayana thana shishyulalo iddarini chuchi
mee yedutanunna graamamunaku velludi; andulo meeru praveshimpagaane kattabadiyunna yoka gaadida pilla kana badunu; daanimeeda e manushyudunu eppudunu koorchunda ledu; daanini vippi, thoolukoni randi.
evadainanu meerenduku eelaagu cheyu chunnaarani mimmu nadigina yedala adhi prabhuvunaku kaavalasiyunnadani cheppudi. thakshaname athadu daanini ikkadiki thooli pampunani cheppi vaarini pampenu.
vaaru vellagaa veedhilo inti bayata thalavaakita kattabadiyunna gaadida pilla yokati vaariki kanabadenu; daanini vippuchundagaa,
akkada nilichiyunna vaarilo kondaru meeremi cheyuchunnaaru? Gaadida pillanu enduku vippuchunnaarani vaarinadigiri.
anduku shishyulu, yesu aagnaapinchinattu vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaru ponichiri.
vaaru aa gaadidapillanu yesunoddhaku thoolukoni vachi, thama battalu daanipai veyagaa aayana daanimeeda koorchuṁ denu.
anekulu thama battalanu daari podugunanu parachiri, kondaru thaamu polamulalo narikina kommalanu parachiri.
mariyu mundu velluchundinavaarunu venuka vachuchundina vaarunu jayamu
prabhuvu perata vachuvaadu sthuthimpabadugaaka vachuchunna mana thandriyaina daaveedu raajyamu sthuthimpabadugaaka sarvonnathamaina sthalamulalo jayamu ani kekalu veyuchundiri.
aayana yerooshalemunaku vachi dhevaalayamulo praveshinchi, chuttu samasthamunu chuchi, saayankaalamainanduna pandrendumandithoo kooda bethaniyaku vellenu.
marunaadu vaaru bethaniyanundi velluchundagaa aayana aakaligoni

aakulugala oka anjoorapu chettunu dooramu nundi chuchi, daanimeeda emainanu dorakunemo ani vacchenu. daaniyoddhaku vachi choodagaa, aakulu thappa maremiyu kanabadaledu; yelayanagaa adhi anjoorapu pandlakaalamu kaadu.
andukaayana ikameedata ennatikini nee pandlu evarunu thinakunduru gaaka ani cheppenu; idi aayana shishyulu viniri.

vaaru yerooshalemunaku vachinappudu aayana dhevaa layamulo praveshinchi, dhevaalayamulo kraya vikraya mulu cheyuvaarini vellagotta naarambhinchi, rookalu maarchuvaari ballalanu, guvvalammuvaari peetalanu padadrosi
dhevaalayamu gunda epaatrayainanu evanini theniyya kundenu.
mariyu aayana bodhinchuchu naa mandiramu samasthamaina anyajanulaku praarthana mandiramanabadunu ani vraayabadaledaa? Ayithe meeru daanini dongala guhagaa chesithiranenu.

shaastrulunu pradhaanayaajakulunu aa maata vini, jana samoohamanthayu aayana bodhaku bahugaa aashcharya paduta chuchi, aayanaku bhayapadi, aayana nelaagu sanharinchudamaa ani samayamu choochuchundiri.
saayankaalamainappudu aayana pattanamulonundi bayaludherenu.
prodduna vaaru maargamuna povuchundagaa aa anjoorapuchettu vellu modalukoni yendiyunduta chuchiri.
appudu pethuru aa sangathi gnaapakamunaku techukoni bodhakudaa, yidigo neevu shapinchina anjoorapuchettu endipoyenani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesu vaarithoo itlanenu meeru dhevuniyandu vishvaasamunchudi.

evadainanu ee kondanu chuchineevu etthabadi samudramulo padaveyabadu mani cheppi, thana manassulo sandhe himpaka thaanu cheppinadhi jarugunani namminayedala vaadu cheppinadhi jarugunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
anduchetha praarthana cheyunappudu meeru aduguchunna vaatinellanu pondiyunnaamani nammudi; appudu avi meeku kalugunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
meeku okanimeeda virodha memainanu kaligiyunna yedala, meeru niluvabadi praarthana cheyunappudellanu vaani kshaminchudi.
appudu paralokamandunna mee thandriyu mee paapamulu kshaminchunu.
vaaru yerooshalemunaku thirigi vachiri. aayana dhevaalayamulo thiruguchundagaa pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu peddalunu aayanayoddhakuvachi
neevu e adhi kaaramuvalana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaavu? Veetini cheyutaku ee yadhikaaramu neekevadicchenani adigiri.
anduku yesunenunu mimmunu oka maata adigedanu, naa kuttharamiyyudi, appudu nenu e adhikaaramuvalana veetini cheyuchunnaano adhi meethoo cheppudunu.
yohaanu ichina baapthismamu paralokamunundi kaliginadaa manushyulanundi kaliginadaa? Naaku uttharamiyyudani cheppenu.
anduku vaarumanamu paralokamunundi kaliginadani cheppinayedala, aayana aalaagaithe meeru endukathani nammaledani adugunu;
manushyulavalana kaligina dani cheppudumaa ani thamalothaamu aalochinchukoniri gaani, andaru yohaanu nijamugaa pravaktha yani yenchiri
ganuka prajalaku bhayapadi'aa sangathi maaku teliyadani yesunaku uttharamichiri. Anduku yesu e adhikaaramu valana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaano adhiyu nenu meethoo cheppananenu.

aayana upamaanareethigaa vaariki bodhimpanaaraṁ bhinchenu; etlanagaa'oka manushyudu draakshathoota naatinchi, daanichuttu kanche veyinchi, draakshalatotti tolipinchi gopuramu kattinchi, kaapulaku daanini gutthakichi dheshaantharamupoyenu.
pantakaalamandu aa kaapula nundi draakshathoota pandlalo thana bhaagamu theesikoni vachutaku, kaapulayoddhaku athadu oka daasunipampagaa
vaaru vaani pattukoni kotti, vattichethulathoo pampivesiri.
marala athadu mariyoka daasuni vaariyoddhaku pampagaa, vaaru vaani thala gaayamuchesi avamaanaparachiri.
athadu mariyokani pampagaa vaanini champiri. Athadinka anekulanu pampagaa, vaaru kondarini kottiri, kondarini champiri.
inkanu athaniki priya kumaarudu okadundenu ganukavaaru thana kumaaruni sanmaaninchedharanukoni thudaku vaari yoddhaku athanini pampenu.
ayithe aa kaapulu ithadu vaarasudu; ithani champudamu randi, appudu svaasthyamu manadagunani thamalothaamu cheppukoni
athanini pattukoni champi, draakshathoota velupala paaravesiri.
kaavuna aa draakshathoota yajamaanudemi cheyunu? Athadu vachi, aa kaapulanu sanharinchi, yitharulaku aa draakshathoota ichunu gadaa. Mariyu
illu kattuvaaru niraakarinchina raayi moolaku thalaraayi aayenu
idi prabhuvuvalanane kaligenu idi mana kannulaku aashcharyamu anu lekhanamu meeru chaduvaledaa? Ani adugagaa
thammunu goorchi aa upamaanamu cheppenani vaaru grahinchi aaya nanu pattukonutaku samayamu choochuchundiri gaani jana samoohamunaku bhayapadi aayananu vidichipoyiri.
vaaru maatalalo aayananu chikkuparachavalenani, parisayyulanu herodeeyulanu kondarini aayana yoddhaku pampiri.

vaaru vachibodhakudaa, neevu satyavanthudavu; neevu evanini lakshyapettanivaadavani me merugudumu; neevu momotamulenivaadavai dhevuni maargamu satyamugaa bodhinchuvaadavu. Kaisaruku pannichuta nyaayamaa kaadaa?
icchedamaa iyyakundumaa? Ani aayana nadigiri. aayana vaari veshadhaarananu erigimeeru nannu enduku shodhinchuchunnaaru? Oka dhenaaramu naa yoddhaku techi choopudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru techiri, aayana'ee roopamunu, pai vraathayu, evarivani vaari nadugagaa vaarukaisaruvi aniri.
anduku yesukaisaruvi kaisarunakunu dhevunivi dhevunikini chellinchudani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaraayananugoorchi bahugaa aashcharyapadiri.
punarut'thaanamu ledani cheppedi saddookayyulu aayana yoddhakuvachi

bodhakudaa, thanabhaarya bradhikiyundagaa okadu pillalu leka chanipoyinayedala vaani sahodarudu vaani bhaaryanu pendlichesikoni thana sahodaruniki santhaa namu kalugajeyavalenani moshe maaku vraasiyicchenu.
eduguru sahodarulundiri. Modativaadu oka streeni pendlichesikoni santhaanamuleka chanipoyenu
ganuka rendavavaadu aamenu pendli chesikonenu, vaadunu santhaa namu leka chanipoyenu; atuvalene moodavavaadunu chanipoyenu.
itlu edugurunu santhaanamulekaye chani poyiri. Andarivenuka aa streeyu chanipoyenu.
punarut'thaanamandu vaarilo evaniki aame bhaaryagaa undunu? aame aa yedugurikini bhaarya aayenu gadaa ani adigiri.
anduku yesumeeru lekhanamulanugaani dhevuni shakthinigaani yerugaka povutavalanane porabadu chunnaaru.
vaaru mruthulalonundi lechunappudu pendlichesikonaru, pendlikiyyabadaru gaani paraloka mandunna doothalavale nunduru.

vaaru lechedharani mruthulanugoorchina sangathi moshe granthamandali podanu gurinchina bhaagamulo meeru chaduvaledaa? aa bhaagamulo dhevudunenu abraahaamu dhevudanu issaaku dhevudanu yaakobu dhevudanani athanithoo cheppenu.
aayana sajeevula dhevudu gaani mruthula dhevudu kaadu. Kaavuna meeru bahugaa porabadu chunnaarani vaarithoo cheppenu.
shaastrulalo okadu vachi, vaaru tharkinchuta vini, aayana vaariki baagugaa uttharamicchenani grahinchi'aagna lannitilo pradhaanamainadhedani aayana nadigenu.
anduku yesu pradhaanamainadhi edhanagaa o ishraayeloo, vinumu; mana dhevudaina prabhuvu advitheeya prabhuvu.
neevu nee poornahrudayamuthoonu, nee poornaatmathoonu, nee poornavivekamuthoonu, nee poornabalamuthoonu, nee dhevudaina prabhuvunu premimpavale nanunadhi pradhaanamaina aagna.
rendavadhi, neevu ninnuvale nee poruguvaanini premimpavale nanunadhi rendava aagna; veetikante mukhyamaina aagna mare diyu ledani athanithoo cheppenu
aa shaastribodhakudaa, baagugaa cheppithivi; aayana advitheeyudaniyu, aayana thappa verokadu ledaniyu neevu cheppina maata satyame.

poorna hrudayamuthoonu, poornavivekamuthoonu, poorna balamuthoonu, aayananu preminchutayu okadu thannu vale thana poruguvaani preminchutayu sarvaanga homamulannitikantenu balulakantenu adhikamani aayanathoo cheppenu.
athadu vivekamugaa nuttharamicchenani yesu grahinchi neevu dhevuni raajyamunaku dooramuga levani athanithoo cheppenu. aa tharuvaatha evadunu aayananu e prashnayu aduga tegimpaledu.
okappudu yesu dhevaalayamulo bodhinchuchundagaa kreesthu, daaveedu kumaarudani shaastrulu cheppuchunnaa remi?
nenu nee shatruvulanu neeku paadapeethamugaa unchu varaku neevu naa kudivaipuna koorchundumani prabhuvu naa prabhuvuthoo cheppenu ani daaveedhe parishuddhaatmavalana cheppenu.
daaveedu aaya nanu prabhuvani cheppuchunnaade, aayana elaagu athani kumaarudagunani adigenu. Saamaanyajanulu aayana maatalu santhooshamuthoo vinuchundiri.
mariyu aayana vaariki bodhinchuchu nitlanenu shaastrulanugoorchi jaagratthapadudi. Vaaru niluvu tangeelu dharinchukoni thirugutanu, santhaveedhulalo vandhanamulanu
samaajamandiramulalo agrapeethamulanu, vindulalo agra sthaanamulanu koruchu
vidhavaraandra yindlu digaminguchu, maayaveshamugaa deerghapraarthanalu cheyuduru.Veeru mari visheshamugaa shiksha ponduduranenu.
aayana kaanukapette yeduta koorchundi, janasamoohamu aa kaanukapettelo dabbulu veyuta choochu chundenu. Dhanavanthulaina vaaranekulu andulo visheshamugaa sommu veyuchundiri.
oka beeda vidhavaraalu vachi rendu kaasulu veyagaa
aayana thana shishyulanu pilichikaanuka pettelo dabbulu vesina vaarandarikante ee beeda vidhavaraalu ekkuva vesenani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
vaarandaru thamaku kaligina samruddhilonundi vesiri gaani, yeeme thana lemilo thanaku kaliginadanthayu, anagaa thana jeevanamanthayu vesenani cheppenu.
aayana dhevaalayamulonundi velluchundagaa aayana shishyulalo okadubodhakudaa, yee raallelaativo yee kattadamulu elaativo choodumani aayanathoo anenu.
anduku yesu'ee goppa kattadamulu choochuchunnaave; raathimeeda raayi yokatiyaina ikkada nilichiyundakunda padadroyabadunani athanithoo cheppenu.
aayana dhevaalayamu eduta oleevala kondameeda koorchundiyundagaa, pethuru yaakobu yohaanu andreya anu vaaru aayananu chuchi
ivi eppudu jarugunu? Ivanniyu neraverabovukaalamunaku e guruthu kalugunu? adhi maathoo cheppumani aayananu ekaantha mandu adugagaa
yesu vaarithoo itlu cheppasaagenu evadunu mimmunu mosapucchakunda choochukonudi.
anekulu naa perata vachinene aayananani cheppi anekulanu mosapucchedaru.
meeru yuddhamulanu goorchiyu yuddhasamaachaaramulanu goorchiyu vinu nappudu kalavarapadakudi; ivi jarugavalasiyunnavi gaani anthamu ventane raadu.
janamumeediki janamunu raajyamumeediki raajyamunu lechunu, akkadakkada bhookampamulu kalugunu, karavulu vachunu. Ive veda nalakupraarambhamu.

mimmunugoorchi meere jaagratthapadudi. Vaaru mimmunu sabhala kappaginchedaru; mimmunu samaajamandiramulalo kottinchedaru; meeru vaariki saakshyaarthamai adhipathula yedutanu raajula yedutanu naa nimitthamu niluvabadedaru.
sakala janamulaku suvaartha mundhugaa prakatimpa badavalenu.
vaaru mimmunu appaginchutaku konipovu nappudu meeru'emi cheppudumaa ani mundhugaa chinthimpakudi, aa gadiyalone meekedi iyyabaduno adhe cheppudi; cheppuvaadu parishuddhaatmaye gaani meeru kaaru.
sahodarudu sahodaruni, thandri kumaaruni, maranamuna kappaginthuru; kumaarulu thalidandrulameeda lechi vaarini champinthuru;
naa naamamu nimitthamu andarichetha meeru dveshimpabaduduru; anthamuvaraku sahinchinavaade rakshana pondunu.
mariyu naashakaramaina heyavasthuvu niluvaraani sthalamandu niluchuta meeru choochunappudu chaduvuvaadu grahinchugaakayoodayalo unduvaaru kondalaku paaripovalenu;
middemeeda unduvaadu intilonundi edainanu theesikonipovutakai digi andulo praveshimpakoodadu;
polamulo unduvaadu thana vastramu theesikonipovutaku intiloniki thirigi raakoodadu.
ayyo, aa dinamulalo garbhinulakunu paalichu vaarikini shrama.
adhi chalikaalamandu sambhavimpakunda valenani praarthinchudi.
avi shramagala dinamulu; dhevudu srujinchina srushtyaadhinundi idivaraku antha shrama kalugaledu, ika ennadunu kalugabodu.

prabhuvu aa dinamulanu thakkuvacheyaniyedala e shareeriyu thappinchu konaka povunu; erparachabadinavaari nimitthamu, anagaa thaanu erparachukonina vaarinimitthamu aayana aa dinamulanu thakkuva chesenu.
kaagaa idigo kreesthu ikkada nunnaadu, adhigo akkada nunnaadu ani yevadainanu meethoo cheppinayedala nammakudi.
aa kaalamandu abaddhapu kreesthulunu abaddhapu pravakthalunu vachi, saadhyamainayedala erparachabadinavaarini mosapuchutakai soochaka kriyalanu mahatkaaryamulanu agaparachedaru.
meeru jaagratthagaa undudi; idigo samasthamunu meethoo mundhugaa cheppi yunnaanu.
aa dinamulalo aa shramatheerina tharuvaatha chikati sooryuni kammunu, chandrudu thana kaanthini iyyadu, aakaashamunundi nakshatramulu raalunu,
aakaashamandali shakthulu kadalimpabadunu.
appudu manushyakumaarudu mahaa prabhaavamuthoonu mahimathoonu meghaaroodhudai vachuta chuchedaru.
appudaayana thana doothalanu pampi, bhoomyanthamu modalukoni aakaashaanthamuvaraku naludikkulanundi thaanu erparachukoninavaarini pogu cheyinchunu.
anjoorapu chettunu chuchi yoka upamaanamu nerchu konudi. daani komma yinka lethadai chigirinchunappudu vasanthakaalamu sameepamugaa unnadani meeku teliyunu.
aa prakaarame meeru ee sangathulu jaruguta choochunappudu aayana sameepamunane dvaaramu daggarane unnaadani telisikonudi.
ivanniyu jarugu varaku ee tharamu gathimpadani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppu chunnaanu.
aakaashamunu bhoomiyunu gathinchunugaani naa maatalu gathimpavu.
aa dinamunu goorchiyu aa gadiyanu goorchiyu thandri thappa e manushyudainanu, paralokamandali dootha lainanu, kumaarudainanu erugaru.
jaagratthapadudi; melakuvagaanundi praarthanacheyudi; aa kaalameppudu vachuno meeku teliyadu.

oka manushyudu thana daasulaku adhikaaramichi, prathivaaniki vaani vaani pani niyaminchimelakuvagaa nundumani dvaarapaalakuniki aagnaapinchi, yillu vidichi dheshaantharamu poyinatte (aa kaalamu undunu.)
inti yajamaanudu proddu grunkivachuno, ardharaatrivachuno, kodikooyunappudu vachuno, tellavaarunappudu vachuno, yeppudu vachuno meeku teliyadu.
aayana akasmaatthugaa vachi meeru nidrabovuchunduta choochunemo ganuka meeru melakuvagaa nundudi.
nenu meethoo cheppuchunnadhi andarithoonu cheppuchunnaanu; melakuvagaa nundudanenu.

rendu dinamulaina pimmata paskaapanduga, anagaa puliyani rottelapanduga vacchenu. Appudu pradhaana yaajakulunu shaastrulunu maayopaayamuchetha aayana nelaagu pattukoni champudumaa yani aalochinchukonu chundiri gaani
prajalalo allari kalugu nemo ani pandugalo vaddani cheppukoniri.

aayana bethaniyalo kushtharogiyaina seemonu inta bhojanamunaku koorchundiyunnappudu oka stree mikkili viluvagala accha jataamaansi attharubuddi theesikoni vachi, aa attharubuddi pagulagotti aa attharu aayana thalameeda posenu.
ayithe kondaru kopapadi ee attharu eelaagu nashtaparachanela?
ee attharu munnooru dhenaaramula kante ekkuva velakammi, beedalakiyyavachunani cheppi aamenugoorchi sanugukoniri.
anduku yesu itlanenu eeme jolikipokudi; eemenu enduku tondharapettuchunnaaru? eeme naayedala manchi kaaryamu chesenu.
beedalu ellappudunu meethoone yunnaaru, meekishtamainappudella vaariki melu cheya vachunu; nenu ellappudunu meethoo nundanu.
eeme thana shakthikoladhichesi, naa bhoosthaapana nimitthamu naa shareeramunu mundhugaa abhishekinchenu.
sarvalokamulo ekkada ee suvaartha prakatimpabaduno akkada eeme chesinadhiyu gnaapakaarthamugaa prashansimpabadunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
pandrendumandilo nokadagu iskariyothu yoodhaa, pradhaanayaajakula chethiki aayananu appagimpa valenani vaariyoddhaku pogaa
vaaru vini, santhooshinchi vaaniki dravyamitthumani vaagdaanamu chesiri ganuka vaadu aayananu appaginchutaku thagina samayamu kanipettu chundenu.

puliyani rottela pandugalo modati dinamuna vaaru paskaapashuvunu vadhinchunappudu, aayana shishyuluneevu paskaanu bhujinchutaku memekkadiki velli siddhaparachavalenani koruchunnaavani aayana nadugagaa,
aayana meeru pattanamuloniki velludi; akkada neellakunda moyuchunna yoka manushyudu meekedurupadunu;
vaani ventaboyi vaadu ekkada praveshinchuno aa yinti yajamaanuni chuchi nenu naa shishyulathoo kooda paskaanu bhujinchutaku naa vididi gadhi yekkadanani bodhakudadugu chunnaadani cheppudi.
athadu saamagrithoo siddhaparachabadina goppa medagadhi meeku choopinchunu; akkada manakoraku siddhaparachu dani cheppi thana shishyulalo iddarini pampenu.
shishyulu velli pattanamuloniki vachi aayana vaarithoo cheppinattu kanugoni paskaanu siddhaparachiri.
saayankaalamainappudu aayana thana pandrendumandi shishyulathoo kooda vacchenu.
vaaru koorchundi bhojanamu cheyuchundagaa yesumeelo okadu, anagaa naathoo bhujinchuchunnavaadu nannu appaginchunani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo cheppagaa
vaaru duḥkhapadinenaa ani yokani tharuvaatha okadu aayana nadugasaagiri.
andukaayana pandrendu mandilo okade, anagaa naathookooda paatralo (cheyyi) munchu vaade.

nijamugaa manushyakumaarudu aayananugoorchi vraayabadinattu povuchunnaadu; ayithe evanichetha manushyakumaarudu appagimpabaduchunnaado, aa manu shyuniki shrama; aa manushyudu puttiyundaniyedala vaaniki melanenu.
vaaru bhojanamu cheyuchundagaa, aayana yoka rottenu pattukoni, aasheervadhinchi virichi, vaarikichimeeru theesikonudi; idi naa shareeramanenu.
pimmata aayana ginnepattukoni kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchi daani vaarikicchenu; vaarandaru daanilonidi traagiri.
appudaayana idi nibandhanavishayamai anekula koraku chindimpabadu chunna naa rakthamu.
nenu dhevuni raajyamulo draakshaarasamu krotthadhigaa traagudinamuvaraku ikanu daanini traaganani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
anthata vaaru keerthana paadi oleevalakondaku velliri.
appudu yesu vaarini chuchimeerandaru abhyanthara padedaru; gorrela kaaparini kottudunu; gorrelu chedaripovunu ani vraayabadiyunnadhi gadaa.
ayithe nenu lechina tharuvaatha meekante mundhugaa galilayaloniki velledhananenu.
anduku pethuru andaru abhyantharapadinanu nenu abhyantharapadanani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesu athani chuchineti raatri kodi rendumaarulu kooyakamunupe neevu nannu eruganani mummaaru cheppedavani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaa nanenu.
athadu mari khandithamugaanenu neethoo kooda chaavavalasi vachinanu ninnu eruganani cheppane cheppananenu. Atlu vaarandarunaniri.
vaaru getsemane anabadina chootunaku vachinappudu, aayana-nenu praarthanachesi vachuvaraku meerikkada koorchundudani thana shishyulathoo cheppi
pethurunu yaakobunu yohaanunu ventabettu konipoyi, migula vibhraanthi nondutakunu chinthaa kraanthudagutakunu aaraṁ bhinchenu
appudaayananaa praanamu maranamagu nanthagaa duḥkhamulo munigiyunnadhi; meerikkada undi melakuvagaa nundudani vaarithoo cheppi
konthadooramu saagipoyi nelameeda padi, saadhyamaithe aa gadiya thanayoddhanundi tolagipovalenani praarthinchuchu
naayanaa thandree, neeku samasthamu saadhyamu; ee ginne naayoddhanundi tolaginchumu; ayinanu naa yishta prakaaramu kaadu nee chitthaprakaarame kaanimmu anenu.
marala aayana vachi vaaru nidrinchuchunduta chuchi seemonoo, neevu nidrinchuchunnaavaa? Okka gadiyayainanu melukoniyundalevaa?
meeru shodhanalo praveshinchakundunatlu melakuvagaa nundi praarthana cheyudi; aatma siddhame gaani shareeramu balaheenamani pethuruthoo cheppi
thirigi poyi, yinthakumundu palikina maatalane palukuchu praarthinchenu.
aayana thirigivachi choodagaa, vaaru nidrinchuchundiri; yelayanagaa vaari kannulu bhaaramugaa undenu, aayanakemi uttharamiyyavaleno vaariki thoocha ledu.
aayana moodava saari vachimeerika nidrapoyi alasata theerchukonudi. Ika chaalunu, gadiya vachinadhi; idigo manushyakumaarudu paapulachethiki appagimpabadu chunnaadu;
lendi velludamu; idigo nannu appaginchu vaadu sameepinchiyunnaadani cheppenu.

ventane, aayana inkanu maatalaaduchundagaa pandrendumandi shishyulalo okadaina iskariyothu yoodhaa vacchenu. Vaanithookooda bahujanulu katthulu gudiyalu pattukoni, pradhaanayaajakulayoddhanundiyu shaastrulayoddhanundiyu peddalayoddhanundiyu vachiri.
aayananu appaginchuvaadu nenevarini muddupettu konduno aayane (yesu); aayananu pattukoni bhadramugaa konipovudani vaariki guruthu cheppiyundenu.
vaadu vachi ventane aayana yoddhaku poyi bodhakudaa ani cheppi, aayananu muddupettukonagaa
vaaru aayanameeda padi aayananu pattukoniri.
daggara nilichi yunnavaarilo okadu katthidoosi pradhaanayaajakuni daasuni kotti vaani chevi teganarikenu.
anduku yesu meeru bandipotu dongameediki vachinattu katthulathoonu gudiyalathoonu nannu pattukona vachithiraa?
nenu prathidinamu dhevaalayamulo meeyoddha undi bodhinchu chundagaa, meeru nannu pattukonaledu, ayithe lekhanamulu neraverunatlu (eelaagu jaruguchunnadani cheppenu).
appudu vaarandaru aayananu vidichi paaripoyiri.
thana digambara shareeramumeeda naarabatta vesikoniyunna yoka paduchuvaadu aayana venta velluchundagaa,vaarathanini pattukoniri.
athadu naarabatta vidichi, digambarudai paaripoyenu.
vaaru yesunu pradhaana yaajakuni yoddhaku theesikoni poyiri. Pradhaanayaajakulu peddalu shaastrulu andarunu athanithookoodavachiri.
pethuru pradhaanayaajakuni yintimungitivaraku dooramunundi aayana ventapoyi bantrauthulathookooda koorchundi, mantayoddha chali kaachu konuchundenu.
pradhaanayaajakulunu mahaasabhavaarandarunu yesunu champimpavalenani aayanameeda saakshyamu vedakirigaani, yemiyu vaariki dorakaledu.
anekulu aayanameeda abaddhasaakshyamu palikinanu vaari saakshyamulu okadaaniki okati saripadaledu.
appudu kondaru lechi chethipaniyaina ee dhevaalayamunu padagotti, moodu dina mulalo chethipanikaani mariyoka dhevaalayamunu nenu kattudunani veedu cheppuchundagaa vintimani
aayanameeda abaddhasaakshyamu cheppiri
gaani aalaagainanu veeri saakshyamunu saripadaledu.
pradhaanayaajakudu vaari madhyanu lechi nilichi uttharamemiyu cheppavaa? Veeru nee meeda paluku chunna saakshyamemani yesu nadigenu.
ayithe aayana uttharamemiyu cheppaka oorakundenu. thirigi pradhaana yaajakuduparamaatmuni kumaarudavaina kreesthuvu neevenaa? Ani aayana nadugagaa
yesu'avunu nene; meeru manushyakumaarudu sarvashakthimanthuni kudipaarshvamuna koorchundutayu, aakaashameghaaroodhudai vachutayu chuchedharani cheppenu.
pradhaanayaajakudu thana vastramulu chimpukoni manaku ika saakshulathoo pani yemi?
ee dhevadooshana meeru vinnaaru kaaraa; meekemi thoochuchunnadani adugagaa vaarandarumaranamunaku paatrudani aayanameeda nerasthaapanachesiri.
kondaru aayanameeda ummivesi aayana mukhamunaku musukuvesi, aayananu gudduchupravachimpumani aayanathoo cheppasaagiri. Bantrauthulunu aayananu arachethulathoo kotti pattukoniri.
pethuru mungiti krindibhaagamulo undagaa pradhaana yaajakuni panikattelalo okate vachi
pethuru chali kaachukonuchunduta chuchenu; athanini nidaaninchi chuchi neevunu najareyudagu aa yesuthoo kooda undinavaadavu kaavaa? Anenu.
andukathadu aayana evado neneru ganu; neevu cheppinadhi naaku bodhapadaledani cheppi nadava loniki vellenu; anthata kodi koosenu.
aa panikatte athanini chuchiveedu vaarilo okadani daggara nilichiyunna vaarithoo marala cheppasaagenu.
athadu maralanenu kaananenu. Konthasepaina tharuvaatha daggara nilichiyunnavaaru marala pethurunu chuchinijamugaa neevu vaarilo okadavu; neevu galilayudavu gadaa aniri.
andukathadu meeru cheppuchunna manushyuni neneruganani cheppi, shapinchukonutakunu ottu bettukonutakunu modalu pettenu.

ventane rendavamaaru kodikoosenu ganukakodi rendu maarulu kooyakamunupu neevu nannu eruganani mummaaru cheppedavani yesu thanathoo cheppina maata pethuru gnaapakamunaku techukoni thalapoyuchu edchenu.
udayamu kaagaane pradhaanayaajakulunu peddalunu shaastrulunu mahaasabhavaarandarunu kalisi aalochana chesi, yesunu bandhinchi theesikonipoyi pilaathunaku appa ginchiri.
pilaathuyoodula raajavu neevenaa? Ani aayana nadugagaa aayana neevannatte ani athanithoo cheppenu.
pradhaanayaajakulu aayanameeda anekamaina neramulu mopagaa
pilaathu aayananu chuchi maralaneevu utthara memiyu cheppavaa? nee meeda veeru ennenni neramulu mopuchunnaaro choodumanenu.

ganuka saayankaalamainappudu arimathayiya yosepu teginchi, pilaathunoddhaku velli yesu dhehamu (thanakimmani) yadigenu. Athadu ghanatha vahinchina yoka sabhyudai, dhevuni raajyamukoraku eduru choochuvaadu.

shathaadhipathi valana sangathi telisikoni, yosepunaku aa shavamu nappaginchenu.
athadu naarabatta koni,aayananu dimpi, aa battathoo chutti, bandalo tolipinchina samaadhiyandu aayananu petti aa samaadhi dvaaramunaku raayi porlinchenu.
magdalene mariyayu yose thalliyaina mariyayu aayana yunchabadina chootu chuchiri.
vishraanthidinamu gadachipogaane magdalene mariyayu yaakobu thalliyaina mariyayu salomeyu vachi, aayanaku pooyavalenani sugandhadravyamulu koniri.
vaaru aadhivaaramuna pendalakada (lechi, bayaludheri) sooryodayamainappudu samaadhiyoddhaku vachuchundagaa,
samaadhi dvaaramunundi manakoraku aa raayi yevadu porlinchunani okarithoo okaru cheppukonuchundiri.
vaaru vachi kannuletthichoodagaa, raayi porlimpabadi yunduta chuchiri. aa raayi yenthoo peddadhi.
appudu vaaru samaadhilo praveshinchi, tellani niluvutangee dharinchu koniyunna yoka paduchuvaadu kudivaipuna koorchunduta chuchi migula kalavarapadiri.
andukathadu kalavarapadakudi siluva veyabadina najareyudagu yesunu meeru vedakuchunnaaru; aayana lechiyunnaadu, ikkada ledu; vaaru aayananu unchina sthalamu choodudi.
meeru velli aayana meekante mundhugaa galilayaloniki velluchunnaa daniyu, aayana meethoo cheppinattu akkada meeru aayananu choothuraniyu aayana shishyulathoonu pethuru thoonu cheppudanenu.
vaaru bayataku vachi, vismayamu nondi vanakuchu samaadhiyoddhanundi paaripoyiri; vaaru bhayapadinanduna evanithoo emiyu cheppa ledu.
aadhivaaramu tellavaarinappudu yesu lechi, thaanu edu dayyamulanu vellagottina magdalene mariyaku modata kanabadenu.

aayana bradhikiyunnaadaniyu aameku kanabade naniyu vaaru vini nammakapoyiri.
